scenes.review: Accepted by lane and root. Exactly Mama foreground right and three children seated at the oak on the left. Lulu alone wears the completed daisy crown; Tutu has one red tail. Mama's profile is readable, with no extra family or owl. The camera shifts to the approach side, so the oak appears left and the right-hand sun differs legitimately from the original frontal oak view; root accepted this change. Visible limbs look plausible. Hidden attachments and exact perspective scale remain unverified.

PinPin lifts his face and looks right toward offscreen Mama, giving a distinct response to her call. No adult appears in this reaction shot, matching narration of an offscreen voice. Grounded front paws look coherent; hidden limbs remain unverified.

scenes.review: Accepted by lane and root. One PinPin is on the path walking toward Mama at right; the oak now holds only Lulu with her completed crown and Tutu with one red tail. Visible empty root space separates departure from the former seated group. Mama is recognizably adult and larger. PinPin faces Mama, so the original claim that he already turns back should move to the following goodbye frame. Visible limbs are distinct and no duplicate actor is present; hidden attachments and exact scale remain unverified.

Mossy stone cottage, closed rounded green door, right knob and left hinges, amber circular windows on both sides, lantern right of door, rear-left chimney and curving stone approach are preserved. Exactly mother left and child right approach together. Quill-covered rear views are plausible; Mama is larger but no exact 2:1 ratio is claimed. No new interior or extra family.
